name: World Nuclear Association
notes: The WNA Information Library is live and free to read (member and shop areas are gated). Its Permission for Use of Content page permits limited reuse: 'You may reproduce sections of up to 150 words from individual pages' with attribution and a link back, plus unaltered use of WNA-marked charts; anything beyond requires specific permission. access=open and reuse_level=full-text-restricted are correct. Evidence: https://world-nuclear.org/information-library and https://world-nuclear.org/general/permission-for-use-of-content (read 2026-11-12)
